name: Oculus World Trade Center
summary: The Oculus World Trade Center is an architecturally iconic shopping destination in Lower Manhattan, featuring Westfield's curated collection of national and international brands within Santiago Calatrava's stunning white-ribbed structure. Located at the World Trade Center site and integrated with the PATH transportation hub, it serves as a premier retail and dining destination for commuters, professionals, and tourists visiting the 9/11 Memorial.
demographics: The Oculus World Trade Center attracts a diverse mix of affluent professionals, international tourists, and business travelers, with visitors typically in the 25-54 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area encompasses Lower Manhattan's financial district workforce, residents of nearby luxury residential developments, and millions of annual tourists visiting the 9/11 Memorial and One World Observatory. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for premium brands, convenience-oriented purchases during work hours, and experiential retail combined with dining and cultural attractions. The center serves as both a daily destination for the area's professional demographic and a must-visit landmark for global visitors seeking iconic New York shopping experiences.
description: The Oculus World Trade Center, officially known as Westfield Shops and Dining at the Oculus, stands as one of New York City's most architecturally stunning retail destinations at 185 Greenwich Street in Lower Manhattan. Designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava, this striking white structure features a soaring ribbed design that evokes a bird in flight, serving as both a transportation hub and a premier shopping center that has become an iconic symbol of renewal at the World Trade Center site. The Oculus seamlessly integrates world-class shopping with the PATH train station, connecting New Jersey commuters and New York residents to an impressive collection of national and international brands. With operating hours Monday through Friday from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm, Saturday from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm, and Sunday from 11:00 am to 7:00 pm, the center provides convenient access to the latest fashion trends and dining experiences in a breathtaking architectural setting. Located steps from the 9/11 Memorial & Museum and One World Observatory, the Oculus has established itself as an essential destination that combines retail therapy with cultural significance, attracting both daily commuters and international visitors who come to experience this remarkable fusion of commerce, transportation, and memorial space in the heart of Lower Manhattan.
